facts.fact: Makueni County Government says its Projects Monitoring and Tracking System, launched in March 2024, has a public dashboard with a feedback tool for citizens to raise concerns or submit comments, managed from the internal dashboard; no count of feedback is given.

systems.platform: web dashboard with SMS and email

facts.fact: Makueni County Government says its own ICT directorate gives ongoing technical support to the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System and its in-house ICT Systems Development team built and deployed it.
Makueni County Government says its in-house ICT team built the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System without external vendors and it was launched in March 2024.

Makueni County Government says the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System was developed by the county's ICT and M&E teams without external vendors and is supported by the ICT directorate, with only cloud hosting, SSL, bulk SMS and email hosting bought as services.

KEN.note: Nothing on connection of county offices.
